card.name: Durations and counts in dosing schedules
card.fires_on: Time units or counts that end a duration phrase, such as days, weeks, doses, or four after for. Also words right after until, after or to that point to a time or event.

modes.label: Duration or count
modes.description: The number-of-time or number-of-doses word that closes a schedule phrase.
